links.outcome: Gastric neoplasm detection change after CAD implementation at two sites
links.effect: At WCH (biopsy rate >95%), GN detection unchanged (1.39% vs 1.36%, OR 0.98) but EGC/GN rose (0.35% vs 0.59%); at RHWU (biopsy rate <20%), GN detection nearly doubled (1.78% vs 3.23%, OR 1.84).
links.quote: The application of CAD devices devoted to distinct increases in gastric neoplasm detection according to different biopsy strategies, which implied that CAD devices demonstrated assistance on gastric neoplasm detection while varied effectiveness according to different implementation scenarios.
